description: Amazon announced that the Amazon Prime Day sale will take place in India in July 2026. The sale will be exclusive to Prime members and will include new product launches and discounts.  There are going to be new deals on electronics, kitchen, beauty, fashion, and fresh grocery product categories during the sale. Amazon Prime Day will be conducted in July in Australia, Brazil, and Japan as well.
title: Amazon Prime Day 2026 India Sale Set for July: Here’s What to Expect

description: Amazon will expand Amazon Now to customers in 100 cities across India. Amazon will scale up its specialised fulfilment infrastructure and expand to over 1,000 micro-fulfilment centres (MFCs) to support this growth. Amazon claims that the latest move will assist more than 16,000 farmers in selling their products on Amazon Now. The expansion is part of Amazon’s investment of over Rs. 2,800 crore.
title: Amazon Now Expands to More Indian Cities With New Micro Warehouses

description: Bakkt has completed its acquisition of Distributed Technologies Research to support its plans for a digital settlement layer. The deal combines Bakkt’s institutional infrastructure with DTR’s stablecoin technology and payments engine for round-the-clock settlement services.
title: Bakkt Acquires DTR to Build Stablecoin Settlement Layer

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra will not feature the 10-megapixel telephoto camera, which offers up to 3x optical zoom, an f/2.4 aperture, PDAF, and optical image stabilisation (OIS), which was present on the previous generations of the Galaxy S Ultra series handsets, a tipster claims. However, whether the sensor will be replaced with an upgraded one or the handset will feature a triple rear camera system remains under wraps. This comes soon after a report highlighted that the Galaxy S27 Ultra will be powered by a custom Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro chipset from Qualcomm.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra Successor Might Skip the 3x Telephoto Rear Camera, Early Leak Suggests

description: Samsung India’s Senior Vice President and head of the company’s mobile business in India has resigned from his position after holding the role for more than four years. Pullan was associated with the South Korean tech conglomerate for nearly 18 years, starting as the Regional Head, West of the company’s mobile business in India. He joined Samsung in June 2008 and assumed the position of Senior Vice President and head of Samsung India’s mobile business in January 2022.
title: Samsung India Mobile Chief Raju Antony Pullan Steps Down; Aditya Babbar to Reportedly Lead MX Operations

description: The Oppo Reno 16 series will launch in China later this month. The lineup will include Reno 16 and Reno 16 Pro models. They could come with MediaTek Dimensity chipsets and  200-megapixel rear camera sensors. They are currently available for reservations in China through the Oppo official store and other e-commerce websites. The standard Reno 16 could feature a 6.3-inch panel, while the Reno 16 Pro could feature a 6.78-inch display.
title: Oppo Reno 16, Reno 16 Pro Set to Launch Later This Month; Pre-Reservations Begin

description: Realme 16T is reportedly under development and is said to hit the market soon. But ahead of it, the handset has appeared on the Geekbench benchmarking site with Android 16 operating system, 8GB RAM and Mali-G57 MC2 GPU. It could run on a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset. For comparison, the Realme 15T has a MediaTek Dimensity 6400 Max SoC under the hood. This chipset has a prime CPU core clocked at 2.50GHz.
title: Realme 16T Geekbench Listing Suggests Possible Performance Downgrade Over Realme 15T

description: Solana-based DeFi protocol Carrot is shutting down after suffering losses linked to the Drift Protocol exploit. The platform said the incident severely affected its operations and has asked users to withdraw funds before the May 14 deadline.
title: Drift Exploit Claims Its First Victim as DeFi Protocol Carrot Shuts Down

description: OnePlus 15 will now retail in India at up to a Rs. 6,000 premium over its launch price, the company updated its website to confirm. Moreover, the tech firm has increased the starting price of the OnePlus 15R for the second time, seeing a price of Rs. 5,000. Similarly, reports suggest that other OEMs, including Redmi, Nothing, and Realme, have also increased the prices of their mid-range smartphones in the country. The price hikes come as the component shortage has led to a cost increase of RAM and memory chips.
title: OnePlus, Nothing and More Smartphone Makers Reportedly Raise Prices of Their Mid-Range, Flagship Handsets as RAM Shortage Rages On

description: Bitcoin traded near $77,100 on Friday as improving liquidity conditions and stable momentum supported the crypto market. Analysts said steady buying activity and balanced market indicators are helping prices remain stable despite limited breakout momentum.
title: Bitcoin Climbs Near $77,000 as Liquidity Trends and Stable Momentum Support Market

description: Xiaomi Civi 5 Pro was launched last year with a Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 chipset and a 6,000mAh battery. Now, Xiaomi appears to be working on the Xiaomi Civi 6 Pro model. It could launch alongside the vanilla Xiaomi Civi 6. Both phones are tipped to feature 1.5K resolution displays and MediaTek Dimensity chipsets. They could feature 50-megapixel rear camera units.
title: Xiaomi Civi 6, Civi 6 Pro Leak Hints at Dimensity Chips and 50-Megapixel Periscope Camera

description: Microsoft has begun rolling out Xbox mode on Windows 11 PCs. The mode brings a console-like interface to Windows, allowing users to browse and launch games across multiple PC storefronts. Xbox mode debuted as the Xbox full-screen experience on Windows handhelds last year.
title: Microsoft Rolls Out Xbox Mode on Windows 11 PCs in Select Markets

description: Google is planning to start showing commercials and sponsored results in the Gemini AI app, according to a report citing Google’s Chief Business Officer, Philipp Schindler. Gemini AI platform, the Mountain View-based tech giant’s conversational AI assistant, currently does not feature ads, unlike its primary competitor ChatGPT. During Google’s quarterly earnings conference call, the company executive reportedly said that currently, it is focusing on ads in Google Search in AI Mode. The company also shows ads below and above the AI Overviews results.
title: Google’s Gemini AI App Could Soon Start Showing Ads, Company Executive Reportedly Hints During Earnings Call

description: YouTube's Picture-in-Picture (PiP) is expanding to more global markets. The feature, that lets users watch YouTube videos in a small window while using other apps, was earlier limited to YouTube Premium members. The PiP feature shrinks the video into a smaller player that keeps playing even after you leave or minimise the YouTube app. Users may need to adjust either app or device settings if it isn’t working properly.
title: YouTube Expands Picture-in-Picture Feature Globally for All Users

description: Star Wars: Galactic Racer, the racing title set in the Star Wars universe, has a release date. The game will be released on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series S/X on October 6, 2026. Pre-orders for Galactic Racer are now live across Steam, Epic Games Store, PS5, and Xbox Series S/X.
title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer Launches October 6, Pre-Orders Now Live

description: Netflix on Thursday announced a new update to its mobile app, introducing new features and design changes for small screens. The update brings a new Clips feature, which is claimed to help users catch glimpses of movies and shows before they start watching them, giving them an idea of what they are getting into. The latest update is currently being rolled out in India, the US, the UK, Australia, Canada, Malaysia, Pakistan, the Philippines, and South Africa. However, the tech firm plans to release its latest update to the rest of the world in the coming months.
title: Netflix Mobile App Gets New ‘Clips’ Feed to Show Users Vertical Videos Amid a Major Design Overhaul

description: Meta has announced that it recorded a “slight decline” in its “Family daily active people (DAP)”, which accounts for the combined daily active users on Instagram, Facebook, Messenger, and WhatsApp, in the first quarter of 2026. Meta's DAP in Q1 2026 was at 3.56 billion on average in the quarter March 2026, which was an increase of about 4 percent from the same period last year. The company said the decline was due to internet disruptions in Iran and restrictions on access to WhatsApp in Russia. However, reports suggest it may be due to the deteriorating quality of feeds on its platforms.
title: Meta Apps Lose 20 Million Daily Active Users in March; Company Reportedly Tweaks Instagram Recommendation Algorithm

description: Samsung Electronics reported consolidated revenue of KRW 133.9 trillion for the first quarter ending March 31, 2026, marking a 43 percent increase compared to the previous quarter. The South Korean brand has posted record operating profit, and its MX and Networks Businesses posted KRW 38.1 trillion in consolidated revenue. However, earnings from the foundry business declined in the same period. The company expects the memory crunch to become even more severe in the coming months.
title: Samsung Hits Record Revenue in Q1 This Year, Expects Memory Shortage to Last Beyond 2027
